messages:
anika: Noticing intermittent TLS handshakes failing on cross-region calls (eu-west -> us-west) since 1789012300. Errors show `ocsp: no staple` and `kms:InvalidCiphertext` on keystore unwrap.
samir: timeline? did anything change to KMS replication or rotator config?
anika: we rotated the intermediate in eu-west at 1789012200 via rotator v2. rotator logs show successful upload to keystore but keystore-controller logs show `unwrap failed: InvalidCiphertext` for a subset of pods.
security-bot: ALERT: svc=proxy-eu reported 6xx for TLS verify failures; ocsp p95 spiked to 800ms for eu-west; cross-region KMS calls (to us-west primary) show increased latency and a handful of `KMS.InvalidCiphertextException`.
ops-jen: did we recently enable cross-region key aliasing? there was a config flip last week to allow us-west key as primary with eu-west replica.
samir: yes, aliasing is on. hypothesis: partial replication lag caused rotator to write ciphertext encrypted under a key version not yet replicated or the keystore picked up a ciphertext intended for local key.
anika: repro attempt on a single node: `kubectl exec -n infra keystore-0 -- /bin/sh -c "cat /var/run/keystore/current.crt | openssl x509 -noout -text"` shows chain includes new intermediate not in proxy CA bundle.
ops-jen: proxies are using node-level CA bundles from configmap `proxy-ca-bundles/eu`. which nodes are missing the intermediate?
anika: `kubectl get ds proxy -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}:{.status.numberReady}\n'` -> seems 2/3 nodes had older bundle. DaemonSet rolling update missed one zone.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0456. Severity: P2. Owner: eng-security.
samir: mitigation plan: 1) force-roll proxy DS in eu-west 2) add temporary OCSP soft-fail in proxy config to avoid hard aborts 3) fallback: have keystore-controller retry unwrap against regional replica key (if decrypt fails, try fallback key id) 4) audit RBAC for keystore-controller to ensure no denied decrypts.
ops-jen: applying hotfix: `kubectl rollout restart ds/proxy -n infra --field-selector=spec.nodeSelector.zone=eu-west-1b` to target the node with old bundle.
anika: also toggling `proxy-tls` configmap to set ocsp.strict=false. snippet: `apiVersion: v1\nkind: ConfigMap\nmetadata: name: proxy-tls\ndata:\n  ocsp_strict: "false"\n  ocsp_timeout_ms: "700"`. ops-jen pls apply carefully.
security-bot: NOTE: CloudTrail shows 4 `kms:Decrypt` errors at 1789012312 for principal `svc/keystore-controller` with error `InvalidCiphertextException`. No AccessDenied in the window.
samir: InvalidCiphertext suggests ciphertext for different key or version mismatch. I'll ask keystore team to log ciphertext key-id metadata on write and verify rotator uses same key-id when writing bundle.
anika: after DS restart and soft-fail change, handshake failures reduced by ~90% within 2m. still seeing a small tail of unwrap errors.
ops-jen: I pushed a temp script to keystore-controller that if unwrap returns InvalidCiphertext, it waits 500ms and retries against regional replica alias. deploying to canary now.
samir: good. long term actions: - enforce rotator -> keystore key-id contract with checksum in artifact - add replication sanity check: before rotator marks rotation complete, query replica key ids for consistency - add CI-check that proxy CA bundles rollout completed across zones during DaemonSet updates - OCSP telemetry alert for p95 > 300ms.
anika: creating follow-ups in JIRA and linking INC-2026-0456. Keeping thread open for 30m.
incident-bot: Update: mitigations applied at 1789012365, handshakes largely recovered.
security-bot: REMINDER: add RBAC audit gate on keystore-controller rolebinding changes; last RBAC mutation was rb-2026-03-10-09.
ops-jen: will coordinate patch + postmortem writeup.
samir: thanks team. will schedule a tabletop for cross-region KMS failover scenarios. :calendar:
